Declared HS 300490 matches the actual customs HS 30049099 — no correction needed. Caveat on volume: all three rows share one BOL and one date, so this is a single shipment event, not a recurring trade flow; no evidence of repeat exports after 2024-10-01 in the free view. Domestic supply side: NOT verified — GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report splits could not be retrieved (zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo search backend was down for the whole session, so no tender/GST pages could be located). Domestic status is therefore 'unknown', not 'none_found' — absence of evidence here reflects tool failure, not a finding of no domestic supply. Revenue and export value: null, not public in the free view. Note the claimed industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is inconsistent with the actual product line (dental anaesthetics, pharma HS 3004) — flag for the industry field, but per project rules this is not a rejection ground.
